messages.content:
You are helping to build a test collection for a multilingual book search engine.

The catalog has 50,000 works (novels, essays, poetry, plays, non-fiction, scholarly open-access books).
Share of works by language of the work: English (en) 41.8%, Spanish (es) 14.5%, French (fr) 6.2%, German (de) 4.1%, Italian (it) 3.5%, Portuguese (pt) 3.5%, Catalan (ca) 1.9%, Dutch (nl) 3.5%, Russian (ru) 3.5%, Chinese (zh) 3.2%, Japanese (ja) 3.5%, Arabic (ar) 3.5%.
Most frequent subjects in the catalog: Science fiction, Fiction, Novels, Fantasy, Essay, Historical fiction, Poetry, Non-fiction, History, British Literature, Crime fiction, Horror fiction, Philosophy & Ethics, Historical Novels, Adventure, Detective fiction, Autobiography, Biography, Thriller, Adventure fiction, American Literature, Children's literature, Mystery fiction, Science-Fiction & Fantasy, Romance, Mythology, Legends & Folklore, Essays, Letters & Speeches, History - Other, French Literature, Plays/Films/Dramas, Comedy, Biographies, Young adult fiction, Children's fiction, Classics of Literature, Drama, Crime literature, Short Stories, Social life and customs, Humour, England, Children & Young Adult Reading, History - European, Travel Writing, Fairy tale, History - Modern (1750+), Description and travel, Religion/Spirituality, Crime, Thrillers and Mystery, Memoir, LGBT-related literature, Romantic fiction, Juvenile fiction, German Literature, United States, France, Early works to 1800, Spy fiction, Philosophy, History - Ancient.

You will not see the catalog itself nor any search result.

Write 12 queries that a user might type into this search box but that a book catalog cannot answer at all, because no book can satisfy them: practical, real-time or personal requests (for example the timetable of a train, today's weather, the price of a flight, a phone number, the opening hours of a shop). One query in each of these languages: English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Catalan (ca), Dutch (nl), Russian (ru), Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Arabic (ar).

Rules: each query entirely in its language; varied requests; do not mention books, reading or literature.
For each query give "need" in English (what the user wants).

Answer with JSON: {"queries": [{"language": "<code>", "text": "...", "need": "..."}]}

raw_output:
{
  "queries": [
    {"language": "en", "text": "train schedule from London to Edinburgh tomorrow morning", "need": "Real-time timetable for trains between London and Edinburgh tomorrow."},
